pages.text: Where there is grain, there are rats, and where there are rats, there is plague. Once the rats have come in earnest, $(4)every ripe crop you harvest$() feeds the Pestilence a little.$(br2)One harvest is nothing. A great farm reaped every day is not.

pages.title: Granaries
pages.text: A field of sixteen or more tilled blocks draws rats by night; they come up out of the crops and eat them to the root. Hay bales and composters count as stores, and four or more make a $(l)granary$(), which draws them at any hour.$(br2)Keep fields small, keep cats, and keep a torch and a blade near the barn.
